channel.title: Vesper AI Radar
channel.description: Новые AI-инструменты и стартапы: что запустилось прямо сейчас — Show HN, GitHub, открытые запуски

item.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
item.description: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.

item.title: All the questions Nvidia should answer on Tuesday — but probably won’t
item.description: Nvidia interim CEO and longtime CFO Colette Kress is about to have one of the biggest days of her career on Tuesday when the company reports its third-quarter results. Given the turmoil Nvidia is in, there are a number of questions that Nvidia should answer.

item.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
item.description: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.

item.title: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security
item.description: Trump contradicted his own government's intelligence officials, who reportedly concluded that Alice Huang is a Chinese spy.

item.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: The industry will be ‘fine’
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.

item.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
item.description: The FBI says that the open source hacking tool was used in cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.

item.title: Jordan Belfort’s new AI voice startup, Tone, wants to sell like the ‘Wolf of Wall Street’
item.description: Belfort claims his AI sales voice can already close deals almost as well as the best human salespeople, and he thinks it will catch up in a year.

item.title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
item.description: OpenAI will embed six Apollo Research evaluators to investigate whether its AI models engage in subversive behavior, but restrictions on access and disclosure raise questions about their independence.

item.title: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
item.description: ChatGPT will ban an account trying to access CSAM content for 24 hours as a warning.

item.title: Audible turns to AI to help users discover audiobooks
item.description: Audible's new AI-generated audio previews summarize a book's themes and what readers liked about it, in addition to playing the narrated sample.

item.title: US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely
item.description: Under the interim rule, the U.S. will require firms to get licenses to export AI chips if they may provide compute to China or other restricted countries.

item.title: Google Maps can now build trip itineraries with real-time details about each stop
item.description: You could use Ask Maps to plan a holiday shopping day trip or something more complex, like a three-day road trip featuring coastal hikes and oceanfront dining.

item.title: Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM
item.description: Dreamteam has signed up more than 100 customers across 13 countries, with some businesses switching from established CRMs.

item.title: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health
item.description: Apple's new app for a study will answer everyday medical questions.

item.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
item.description: Bharat Semi says it has secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology with companies, including General Atomics.

item.title: Is bad news for Jensen Huang also bad news for the AI industry?
item.description: "Jensen is Nvidia, right? And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia."

item.title: ‘SNL’ gathers all the tech tycoons for a lesson in dating and spycraft
item.description: While awkward, creepy tech executives have become a recurring theme on Saturday Night Live, this week’s episode gave the cast a chance to show off all their impressions at once.
